lane: DISCOVERY -- development folds only, not promotion evidence
feature_source_note: v1 canonical columns used as-is (LEAKY -- null pattern == did_appear)
sign_convention: INCUMBENT(D) minus CHALLENGER absolute error; POSITIVE = challenger beats D
multiplicity_statement: 7 new bounded nonlinear variants are tested on one primary metric. No correction is applied to the reported 90% CIs; instead the reader is told the count. A single nominally positive arm out of 7 at 90% is close to what chance alone delivers (expected ~0.35 false positives per tail), so no single positive arm is evidence.

amendments.origin: coordinator, after the ws7 fits had been run and inspected
amendments.what: a second baseline. Another workstream found that every Poisson-ridge arm carries an unpenalised intercept that the unfitted Arm D does not, so free recalibration alone is worth roughly +0.0033 operational team MAE -- the same magnitude as the effects ws7 is hunting.
amendments.integrity_note: K0 was NOT part of the frozen design and was added with the results already visible. It is a BASELINE, not a candidate: it can only make every reported arm look worse, never better, so it cannot manufacture a positive. It is excluded from NEW_VARIANTS and does not change the multiplicity count, which stays at 7.
amendments.consequence: every arm is now reported against BOTH Arm D (as registered) and K0. vs-K0 is the honest test of whether the FUNCTIONAL FORM adds anything beyond recalibration.

vs_K0_recalibration_baseline.interpretation: vs_K0 is the honest test of the FUNCTIONAL FORM. An arm positive vs D but not vs K0 bought its gain with a free intercept.

gate_selftest.note: no arm in this workstream includes both columns
